description: Unit test file for the FrameType class template in the core module of WPEFramework, utilizing Google Test framework to test buffer operations and object copying.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A template class representing a frame buffer with read/write capabilities used in the test scenarios.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets the buffer data at a specified offset and length, returning a status or size.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves buffer data starting at a specified offset and length into a provided array.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Get or set the size of the frame buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets or clears the frame buffer.
